page.text:
The center $Z(G)$ is precisely the kernel of the conjugation homomorphism
$\operatorname{Inn} : G \to \operatorname{Aut}(G)$ defined by
$g \mapsto (x \mapsto g * x * g^{-1})$. By the First Isomorphism Theorem,
the group of inner automorphisms satisfies
$\operatorname{Inn}(G) \cong G / Z(G)$. Thus the quotient $G/Z(G)$
measures the non-abelian core of $G$ accessible via internal symmetries.
